Oatmeal Cranberry Cookies
By: Four Seasons Ho...
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 7:25am

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon all spice
2 eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla
3/4 cup shortening
3/4 cup brown sugar
3/4 ultra find bakers sugar
1 1/2 cups oats
1 1/2 cups dried cranberries
1/2 bag semi-sweet chocolate chips (optional)

Preparation

1 Cream together shortening and sugars.  Combine well.  Add vanilla, combine.  Add eggs, combining after each. 2 In a separate bowl, sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon,  and all spice.  Add in oats and cranberries. 3 Add dry ingredients to wet, mix well.  Stir to evenly distribute. 4 Bake for 10-12 minutes on 350 degrees.

About


Note: This recipe was submitted by Amanda Rettke to the Four Seasons Hotel Seattle's Ultimate Holiday Cookie Contest.
Cranberries and cinnamon are a knockout combination in this delicious Holiday cookie.  These cookies make you feel like you are experiencing something rich and decadent. They stimulate your senses, and bring back wonderful memories of Holidays past.
The key to this recipe is the ingredients.  I use as many all organic fresh products as possible... especially with the oats and cranberries.
For extra fun, melt chocolate chips and drizzle over the top.
